evidence: Enlisted v1.2.1.3 archive (read from origin/26.2(main), SHA-256 a0dc616286fc43146e2c6b94ee3bae141a4e6aff65a3fece2370f8388ab057f5): data/ww/index/guns/mp38.json and data/ww/data/guns/mp38_data.json were checked for this exact GunId, ammo and base capacity.
Each archived model contains its own magwell/magazine reload presentation; the family is an explicit historical interchangeability decision, not an ammo-plus-capacity grouping.
MP38, MP40 and MP41 are the deliberately reviewed shared 32-round box-magazine interface; no other 9 mm SMG is added to this family.
The sidecar remains runtime-guarded against the loaded GunData ammo and base capacity; each declared carrier variant is an exact selectable first-three extended_mag_ammo_amount value.
